subject: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan — next steps & milestones
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T15:05:00Z
Subject: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan — draft attached

Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo slot today. Per our conversation I’m sharing a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) with the technical evaluation milestone fleshed out so you can see what success will look like and who owns what. Key excerpts below — please review and tell me if anything should change: 

Technical evaluation (milestone #2) — draft success criteria:
- Latency: P95 inference latency <= 200ms for typical prompt mix (avg prompt length ~120 tokens)
- Cost target: inferencing unit cost <= $0.50 per 1k output tokens under expected QPS
- Throughput: sustain 40+ req/s on a single reserved pool for 8k context workloads
- Quality: automated evals (BLEU/ROUGE where applicable) + human spot-check pass rate >= 85% on your labeled test set

Model shortlist (for benchmarking):
- meta-llama-2-70b (quantized profile)
- MPT-30B-instruct (8k)
- OpenChat-13B (optimized runtime)

Dependencies / asks from Acme AI:
- Provide a representative test dataset (CSV/JSON) and 200 annotated examples for human spot checks
- Share expected prompt distribution and peak QPS targets
- Temporary access to staging credentials or a sample payload schema for integration tests

Target close date for Phase 1 (PO + MAP sign-off): 2026-03-31 (we can adjust based on security/compliance timing)

Next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the stakeholders who will sign off on the technical evaluation? (e.g., engineering lead + product)
2) Can you share the test dataset and sample payloads by EOD next week (Mar 5)?
3) I’ll schedule a 60-min technical kickoff (Redwood SRE + SEs + your infra) — proposed slots: Mar 9/10. Which works for you?

I’ve attached the MAP draft and a one-page evaluation plan for clarity.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- 20260304_MAP_draft.xlsx (MAP draft, milestone table)
- tech_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx (one-page evaluation checklist)

From: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan — draft attached

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear draft — this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications before we confirm stakeholders and dates: 

1) Test dataset: we can provide a redacted dataset and the 200 annotated examples by Mar 5. Will that be sufficient or do you need additional metadata fields included?
2) Staging access: we won’t provide credentials into our infra. Instead we’d prefer Redwood run the benchmarks against a staging endpoint we’ll host (we can give IP allowlist + temporary API token). Is that ok?
3) Cost target: the $0.50/1k tokens target sounds reasonable for scoped workloads — can you confirm this assumes quantized models and batching?

Stakeholders:
- Myself (Product)
- Tom Lewis (Engineering manager) — will be lead reviewer for the technical eval
- Procurement (TBD) — will join later for PO/terms

We’ll tentatively hold Mar 9 for the kickoff — let me know what time works.

Thanks,
Jane
VP Product, Acme AI
jane.park@acmeai.com

Attachments referenced: acme_security_qs.pdf (we’ll start filling this and share next week)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T13:40:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan — clarification on procurement/SOW

Quick note from procurement side: once the MAP milestones and success criteria are agreed, we’ll issue a short SOW that maps to the milestones (benchmarks, staging support, performance tuning). Typical lead times for Dedicated pool provisioning is 2–3 weeks after PO. If you need an accelerated schedule we can convert to an interim hosted-run with an SLA addendum.

Responsibility summary (for clarity):
- Redwood: execute benchmarks, provide staging endpoints for evaluation, produce results report and run tuning iterations
- Acme AI: provide dataset, annotated examples, allowlist for test endpoint, and final sign-off on quality metrics

I’ll start drafting the SOW stub and share in HubSpot — would love to lock the target close date after we confirm the security questionnaire timeline.

— Aditya
Principal Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@acmeai.com>
Cc: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@acmeai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-07T11:22:00Z
Subject: MAP: Technical Evaluation Plan — updated timeline & owners (v2)

Hi all —

Per follow-ups I’ve updated the MAP and attached tech_evaluation_plan_v2.xlsx with an explicit milestone table and responsibility matrix. Summary of updates: 

Milestone: Technical evaluation (v2)
- Target start: 2026-03-09 (technical kickoff)
- Target completion: 2026-03-28 (benchmark runs + report)
- Sign-off: Tom Lewis (engineering) + Jane Park (product)

Adjusted target close for Phase 1 (PO + MAP sign-off): 2026-04-07 (extension to accommodate security QS review)

Benchmark success criteria (finalized):
- Latency: P95 <= 200ms (8k context, typical prompt mix)
- Cost: <= $0.45 per 1k output tokens (assumes q4 quantized profile and batching)
- Throughput: sustain 45 req/s on Dedicated pool (8k) with autoflow batching
- Quality: human spot-check pass rate >= 85% on provided annotations; no critical regressions vs current baseline

Model shortlist for first pass (Redwood to run in order):
1) meta-llama-2-70b (q4_0 quantized profile)
2) MPT-30B-instruct (8k)
3) OpenChat-13B (optimized runtime)

Responsibilities (high-level):
- Redwood (Dylan + SE team): run benchmarks, provide interim staging endpoint, share raw benchmark logs + analysis
- Acme AI (Tom + Eng): provide sample payloads, test dataset, allowlist for staging endpoint, availability for sign-off reviews
- Procurement (Jane + Acme legal): finalize PO and SOW; Redwood (Aditya) to provide SOW stub

Open dependencies: Acme security questionnaire (we’re awaiting filled copy), dataset delivery (by Mar 5 as discussed), and confirmation of the kickoff time on Mar 9.

Proposed kickoff times (all PDT): Mar 9 — 09:00 or 14:00. Please pick one and I’ll send calendar invite.

Thanks — I’ll also upload the updated MAP and tech plan to the HubSpot deal and Drive folder.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
